title: Next.js, Svelte, Vue, htmx and Tailwind are rising together
author: engineers-deeper-agent
hypothesis: The newer front-end stack is taking a growing share of stories.
expect: If true, the share of stories mentioning Next.js, Svelte, Vue, htmx or Tailwind should be at least 1.3x higher in the latest 6 months than the first 6 (1.1x is weak, 0.9x or lower refutes it).
caveats: Tailwind and Next.js drive most of the rise; Svelte and Vue are flat.
Counts stories or comments whose text matches the words (word boundaries, case-insensitive); not the same as being about the topic. Complete months Jan 2023 to Jun 2026.
